notes.repetition_rationale: 10 repetitions per (architecture, scenario) was not derived from any project documentation specifying a repetition count, so the Milestone 14A default of 10 is used: enough repeated observations for a meaningful consistency measurement (src.evaluation.metrics.compute_consistency), a manageable real-inference time budget relative to the controlled 11-scenario x 3-architecture design, and substantially stronger than a one-shot evaluation. This is a pragmatic experimental-design choice, not a claim that 10 is statistically optimal.
notes.scenario_set_rationale: Reuses DEFAULT_SCENARIO_IDS (src/evaluation/tool_agent_evaluation.py) verbatim rather than defining a new scenario subset for this milestone: the same representative 11-scenario controlled-benchmark subset already established and exercised throughout Milestones 9B-13 (positive/negative/mixed-sign odds, a best-line tie, a missing-sportsbook case, a current/stale freshness case, moneyline/spread/total markets, quant-evaluable positive- and negative-EV cases). The 3 excluded scenarios from the full 14-scenario benchmark (S010/S011: additional freshness cases duplicating S009's category; S014: a hand-verification-only positive-odds case duplicating S001's category) were excluded from this representative subset for that reason at the time DEFAULT_SCENARIO_IDS was defined, not newly excluded here to influence final results.
notes.architecture_order_rationale: architectures is left in DEFAULT_ARCHITECTURE_ORDER ([rag, tool, hybrid]) — src.experiments.config.execution_order_for_repetition() rotates this list deterministically per repetition (Milestone 12), so this ordering only fixes repetition 1's order; it is not a fixed running order for the whole experiment.
notes.provider_change_v1_1: Pre-Milestone 14A 'Local Real-LLM Backend' checkpoint: llm_provider/model_name/temperature changed from the Anthropic API (claude-opus-4-8, effort=low) to a locally hosted Ollama model (llama3.1:8b, temperature=0.0) so the final experiment can run without per-call API cost. This edit was made BEFORE any run under experiment_id=final_v1 was ever started (results/experiments/final_v1/ does not exist) — Milestone 14A's own rule against changing settings mid-experiment does not apply; this is pre-run preparation, per that checkpoint's own Step 11. effort=low is left in the config for documentation continuity but is inert/ignored by OllamaLLMClient (Anthropic-only field).
notes.model_choice_rationale: llama3.1:8b was selected as the ONE model for all three architectures after verifying locally (not merely assumed) that it supports both schema-constrained structured JSON output (RAG's generate_structured) and native multi-turn tool calling, including a full tool-call -> tool-result -> final-answer round trip (TOOL/HYBRID's create_turn) — see experiments/run_ollama_three_architecture_smoke_test.py and its passing run against all three architectures. temperature=0.0 is Ollama's lowest-deterministic-setting lever (DEFAULT_OLLAMA_TEMPERATURE), the equivalent role effort=low played for the Anthropic provider.
notes.canonical_query_template: Compare the available {market_type} prices for {selected_outcome} and identify the best current value. (src.experiments.config._canonical_query — takes no architecture parameter; identical wording reaches all three architectures for a given scenario.)

prompt_constants.hybrid_agent: uses both prompt constants above verbatim (src.agents.hybrid_agent) — no separate hybrid-specific prompt exists
prompt_constants.hash_capture: sha256 hashes of both prompt constants' literal string content are captured by src.experiments.fingerprint.compute_final_experiment_fingerprints() and stored in the run's metadata.json, compared before/after execution (Section 24).

notes.output_directory_convention: output_dir + experiment_id = results/experiments/final_v1/ — satisfies the milestone's 'results/experiments/final_<experiment_id>/' convention via the experiment_id itself carrying the final_ prefix, without needing a runner.py directory-naming change.
notes.uncommitted_changes_note: Milestones 12 and 13's code (src/experiments/, dashboard/, associated tests), this Pre-14A local-provider checkpoint's changes, and this config edit are NOT committed as of freezing this config — see the run's environment_metadata.json (git_status/git_diff_stat) for the exact traceable working-tree state at run time. Per project convention, commits are only made when the user explicitly requests one.
